entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I was so excited for it, but it's just not working at all. I'm... I'm really disappointed.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault. I've tried everything, and it just won't sync with the app. I think the sensor inside must be broken or something. Honestly, for what I paid, I feel like it's just defective.
I understand your frustration. It's definitely disappointing when a new product doesn't perform as expected. Let me just pull up your order information.
Okay. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this has never happened. I really needed this money for some bills if it wasn't going to work out, you know?
I completely understand. Okay, I have your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 9 days ago. Let me just check our return policy for you... one moment.

Alright, I've confirmed it. Since you received the item just 9 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now. No need to troubleshoot a defective item.
Oh, really? Wow. That's... that's a huge relief. Are you sure? That's amazing, thank you so much, Diana.

Of course. I'm happy to get this sorted out for you. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box and drop it off at any post office.
I will. Thank you again. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
